Dedup in. Same `key` within 5 minutes of last delivery → dropped, 99 total (the flap repeats plus same-key collisions).

- low: email 111, queue 90
- normal: push 112, queue 88
- high: sms 112 + email 112, queue 88
- critical: pager 200

0 errors.

Two calls I made — say word if wrong:
- Window inclusive: `at - lastSentAt <= 5` drops at exactly 5 min.
- Suppressed repeats do not refresh the timer; only real deliveries do. So a steady flap can't hold suppression open forever.
